query:
INSERT INTO user_credentials (sub, token_cipher, key_id, failures, created_at, updated_at)
         VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 0, $4, $4)
         ON CONFLICT (sub) DO UPDATE
            SET token_cipher = EXCLUDED.token_cipher,
                key_id = EXCLUDED.key_id,
                last_error = NULL,
                failures = 0,
                updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
